## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed grading activity during the quarter, reading 930 sets over 434 rostered hours. This represents an average throughput of 2.1 sets per hour. The workload was recorded for review alongside the associated quality checks. On the information available, the reported volume and hours provide a clear basis for considering the grader’s activity during the period.

The review found no indication that workload levels required additional intervention. The work completed is noted as part of the routine quarterly assessment.

## Quality

A sample of 77 graded sets was checked as part of the review. The recorded agreement rate was 50.6 per cent. This result is retained for the quality record and should be considered alongside the workload information above.

Priya Anand reviewed the grading record and confirmed the findings. No further action is required this quarter.
